changelog: 📁 Complete Digital Health Records Module (/health-records) with EHR / PHR capabilities
🩺 Personal Medical History tracking: existing conditions, previous surgeries, allergies, family history, and clinical notes
📑 Secure Medical Documents Archive: PDF and image upload for lab reports, prescriptions, discharge slips, and scans with magic-byte validation
⏳ Chronological Health Timeline: consultations, lab tests, surgeries, medication titrations, and hospital visits
💓 Continuous Health Vitals: manual logging of BP, Pulse, SpO2, Temperature, and Blood Glucose with AHA/clinical bands
📈 Interactive Empirical Vitals Charts: historical trend plots with standard clinical reference bands and zero inferencing
📄 Printable Doctor Consultation Summary: physician-ready PDF export with full clinical dossier and signature block
🔐 Strict Privacy & Caregiver Access Management: cryptographic client-side encryption and authorized caregiver permissions
